seo_desc: Christmas events for kids in Haughton, Louisiana for 2026: 6 family events with dates, times and addresses checked on each host's site.
lede: Haughton celebrates Christmas with a volunteer-run parade and festival, library Santa visits and a gingerbread house contest.
celebrates: Christmas in Haughton, an independent volunteer nonprofit, anchors the season with its 10th annual Parade, Festival and Firework Show on Saturday, December 12. The Bossier Parish Libraries add programs at both Haughton branches, including Glitter Mickey Ornaments on December 5, a Santa visit on December 19, Christmas with Red River Santa and Mrs. Claus at East 80 Library on December 21, and a gingerbread house contest that runs December 1 to 29.
lastyear: Christmas in Haughton says its first event was held in 2017 and that 2026 is its tenth year, so last year's parade and festival was the ninth. The 2026 edition adds a firework show to mark the anniversary. These counts come from the organizer's own website.
facts: Haughton is a town in Bossier Parish, Louisiana, with a population of 4,539 at the 2020 census, and it is part of the Shreveport-Bossier City metropolitan area, according to the Town of Haughton's community page.
trains: We found no Christmas train ride in Haughton. The Shreveport and Bossier City pages list the nearest holiday events.
traditions: A volunteer nonprofit's parade, festival and fireworks show, free for the community and in its tenth year in 2026.
The Bossier Parish Libraries run Santa visits, craft days and a gingerbread house contest at the Haughton and East 80 branches.
kidfact: Christmas in Haughton began in 2017, and its tenth anniversary in 2026 comes with the first firework show.
faq: The volunteer group Christmas in Haughton holds a parade and festival each December, and the Bossier Parish Libraries host Santa visits, crafts and a gingerbread house contest.
When is the Haughton Christmas parade in 2026?
The organizer's site lists the 10th annual parade, festival and firework show for Saturday, December 12, and had not posted times when we checked on November 26.
Where can kids meet Santa in Haughton?
The Haughton Library Santa visit is December 19 and Christmas with Red River Santa and Mrs. Claus at East 80 Library is December 21.

intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Haughton for 2026, and here is what he found: 6 family events. The magic runs from December 1 (the East 80 Library gingerbread house contest) through December 29, with Glitter Mickey Ornaments (December 5), the 10th annual Christmas in Haughton Parade, Festival and Fireworks (December 12), the Haughton Library Santa visit (December 19) and Christmas with Red River Santa and Mrs. Claus (December 21) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Haughton

  • 6 Christmas events for kids in Haughton
  • Free: the Christmas in Haughton Parade, Festival and Fireworks (December 12), which the organizer calls free for the community
  • Meet Santa: the Haughton Library Santa visit (December 19) and Christmas with Red River Santa and Mrs. Claus at East 80 Library (December 21)
  • Parades and fireworks: the 10th annual Christmas in Haughton Parade, Festival and Fireworks (December 12)
  • Crafts: Glitter Mickey Ornaments (December 5), the East 80 gingerbread house contest (December 1 to 29) and holiday crafts and movies (December 22 and 23)
  • Season: December 1 to December 29

Planning a bigger day out? Haughton families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Bossier City, a short drive west, and in Shreveport, across the Red River.
